text:
Nina: FYI we have several tenants where invoice_preview != final_invoice after they hit region-failover to Dedicated under load. Amounts differ because finalizer applies a pricing override and emits a new event instead of mutating the preview.
Cole: Ouch. Do we have an example so we can see the fields?
Nina: Yep, minimal pair below (same request but different route+price):
```json
{"req":"req_aa34","tenant":"foxcorp","route":"edge-hosted","tokens":300}
{"req":"req_aa34","tenant":"foxcorp","route":"eu-dedicated","tokens":300,"price_adjust":"dedicated_flat"}
```
Priya: If finalizer appends instead of overwriting preview, downstream invoice builder sums both. We need a deterministic canonical billing key so consumers can collapse duplicates.
Sam: Agree. Suggest canonical_key = tenant + req + route_group + billing_epoch. route_group groups route variants (hosted/dedicated) so previews and finals map.
Dylan: Schema change on hot path worries me. Looking up route_group at router is cheap, finalizer shouldn't have to query extra stores. Can router populate route_group early?
Cole: Router can add billing_metadata: {route_group, preview_id}. That keeps finalizer simple: it can upsert by preview_id into a compacted topic.
Priya: Upsert+compaction feels best. Invoice builder reads compaction snapshot so only the last write wins. Need clear contract: preview records have preview=true, finals set finalized=true and replace preview record.
Nina: Another option is an overwrite token: finalizer emits an event with overwrite_of=preview_id which preview consumer uses to replace. But that requires every preview consumer to implement replacement semantics. Upsert centralizes the behavior.
Sam: For burst cases we could add a small in-memory short-window dedupe cache (5s-30s) to catch immediate duplicates and avoid repeated writes, but keep the compacted topic as source-of-truth.
Dylan: Bloom filter for extreme QPS is an option but false positives cause missed charges. Not acceptable for billing.
Cole: Action items: 1) propose canonical key proto (Cole), 2) router to emit billing_metadata (Nina), 3) create compacted kafka topic invoices.v2 (Priya + Sam), 4) finalizer writes upserts and marks finalized (Priya).
Priya: I'll PR the schema change. We'll version the proto and make preview consumers tolerate unknown fields.
Nina: UX: Console should flag rows as "pending pricing" with a hover explaining dedicated overrides. Exports should include preview_id and finalized flag so Finance can reconcile.
finance-bot: Finance notification: Please add commit note for CSV exports: column "finalized" and "pricing_source" required for compliance.
Dylan: Metrics plan: emit preview_count, final_count, and preview_to_final_delta_usd per tenant. Add alert when delta pct > 0.25% for 30m.
Sam: Rollout: feature flag in finalizer, canary on low-volume tenants for 24h, then 10%; have an automated smoke replay that simulates failover to dedicated and checks preview==final.
Cole: Reconciliation: write a backfill job to collapse last 72h by canonical key and emit correction entries for any invoices that changed > $0.50.
Priya: I'll own the backfill job and the schema PR.
Nina: I'll coordinate with Console team for the pending pricing badges and Finance for comms.
Dylan: I'll add dashboards and the alert.
Sam: I'll wire up the compacted topic and a lightweight in-memory cache for duplicates.
finance-bot: Ticket FIN-1209 opened for exports changes.
Nina: Thanks all. Aim to start canary tomorrow 08:00 PT. Post any concerns here before EOD.
